name: build-bell
description: A counter-bell strike and a toast when a long command or a long turn finishes, so you can look away while a build, an install, a test run or Claude goes. It says how long it took and whether it failed. Quiet for anything short.

minSeconds.title: Ring after (seconds)
minSeconds.description: A command or a turn that runs this long rings and shows a toast. Shorter ones stay quiet.

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: Ring the bell. Off leaves the toast alone.

shortTurns.title: Tick after short turns
shortTurns.description: A soft tick when a turn of 5 seconds or more ends without reaching the bell.
